description: The labelled local sample of C18 §11.2: short documents about the organisation of testsuite/ask/org.ttl, each with gold facts in the demo vocabulary and the quote that supports each fact. A subject or object `_:key` is a new entity that the document introduces, listed with its label and types under `entities`. Every other IRI is a link to an existing entity. The documents are Markdown and plain text. HTML and PDF documents join the sample with the server-side conversion of Phase 4. scripts/eval-ingest scores an ingestion of the sample.
